title: Scaling similarity and generalised conformal symmetry in D2-brane holography
summary: We study D2-brane holography within the purely dilatonic sector of four-dimensional maximal ISO(7)-gauged supergravity, obtained as a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on S$^6$. In the dual frame, the four-dimensional Lagrangian resulting from the reduction of the massless IIA theory exhibits scaling similarity, thus reflecting the generalised conformal symmetry of the dual three-dimensional maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory.
